asset.rationale: Alpine 'virt' ISO ships a Virtualization.framework-ready x86_64 kernel (boot/vmlinuz-virt) and matching initramfs (boot/initramfs-virt) with virtio drivers built in; boots headless with console=hvc0 init=/bin/sh.
asset.note: ISO SHA-256 published by Alpine at the .sha256 sidecar URL above (fetched and confirmed during prototype build). Full download + hash verification runs inside run-native-stage0a.sh (asset stage). WorkBuddy network was throttled (~50 KB/s) so the 63 MB download was deferred to native Terminal; the asset itself is a verifiable official upstream, not BLOCKED.
